import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Fetch Central station coordinates (station_id = 16)
query_central = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS lat, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS lon
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 16
""")
central_df = pd.read_sql(query_central, engine)
print("Central station:")
print(central_df)
central_lat = central_df['lat'].values[0]
central_lon = central_df['lon'].values[0]
print(f"RESOLVED: Central = id 16, lat={central_lat}, lon={central_lon}")

# Step 2: Fetch all other stations
query_others = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS lat, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS lon
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id != 16
ORDER BY id
""")
others_df = pd.read_sql(query_others, engine)
print(f"\nOther stations count: {len(others_df)}")
print(others_df)

# Step 3: Compute relative position and classify into quadrants
others_df['rel_lat'] = others_df['lat'] - central_lat
others_df['rel_lon'] = others_df['lon'] - central_lon

ne_mask = (others_df['lat'] > central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] > central_lon)
nw_mask = (others_df['lat'] > central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] < central_lon)
se_mask = (others_df['lat'] < central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] > central_lon)
sw_mask = (others_df['lat'] < central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] < central_lon)

others_df['quadrant'] = 'UNCLASSIFIED'
others_df.loc[ne_mask, 'quadrant'] = 'NE'
others_df.loc[nw_mask, 'quadrant'] = 'NW'
others_df.loc[se_mask, 'quadrant'] = 'SE'
others_df.loc[sw_mask, 'quadrant'] = 'SW'

print("\nClassification results:")
print(others_df[['id', 'name_en', 'lat', 'lon', 'rel_lat', 'rel_lon', 'quadrant']])

# Step 4: Count stations in each quadrant
ne_count = int(ne_mask.sum())
nw_count = int(nw_mask.sum())
se_count = int(se_mask.sum())
sw_count = int(sw_mask.sum())

print(f"\nQuadrant counts:")
print(f"NE: {ne_count}")
print(f"NW: {nw_count}")
print(f"SE: {se_count}")
print(f"SW: {sw_count}")
print(f"Total classified: {ne_count + nw_count + se_count + sw_count}")

# Check for any unclassified stations
unclassified = others_df[others_df['quadrant'] == 'UNCLASSIFIED']
if len(unclassified) > 0:
    print(f"\nWARNING: {len(unclassified)} stations unclassified (exactly on Central's lat/lon):")
    print(unclassified[['id', 'name_en', 'lat', 'lon']])

# The quadrant counts are already staged in the shared runtime.
# Verify they exist and cast to plain Python int.

ne_count = int(ne_count)
nw_count = int(nw_count)
se_count = int(se_count)
sw_count = int(sw_count)

print(f"ne_count = {ne_count}")
print(f"nw_count = {nw_count}")
print(f"se_count = {se_count}")
print(f"sw_count = {sw_count}")

# Quick sanity check
total = ne_count + nw_count + se_count + sw_count
print(f"Total classified stations: {total}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get Central station coordinates
query_central = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE name_en = 'Central'
""")
central_df = pd.read_sql(query_central, engine)
print("Central station:")
print(central_df)

central_lat = central_df['lat'].values[0]
central_lon = central_df['lon'].values[0]
central_id = central_df['id'].values[0]
print(f"\nCentral coords: lat={central_lat}, lon={central_lon}, id={central_id}")

# Step 2: Get all other stations
query_others = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id != :central_id
""")
others_df = pd.read_sql(query_others, engine, params={"central_id": int(central_id)})
print(f"\nTotal other stations: {len(others_df)}")
print(others_df.to_string())

# Step 3: Classify into quadrants
# NE: lat > central_lat AND lon > central_lon
# NW: lat > central_lat AND lon < central_lon
# SE: lat < central_lat AND lon > central_lon
# SW: lat < central_lat AND lon < central_lon

ne_mask = (others_df['lat'] > central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] > central_lon)
nw_mask = (others_df['lat'] > central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] < central_lon)
se_mask = (others_df['lat'] < central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] > central_lon)
sw_mask = (others_df['lat'] < central_lat) & (others_df['lon'] < central_lon)

ne_count = int(ne_mask.sum())
nw_count = int(nw_mask.sum())
se_count = int(se_mask.sum())
sw_count = int(sw_mask.sum())

print(f"\nNE quadrant: {ne_count}")
print(f"NW quadrant: {nw_count}")
print(f"SE quadrant: {se_count}")
print(f"SW quadrant: {sw_count}")
print(f"Total classified: {ne_count + nw_count + se_count + sw_count}")

# Show which stations are in each quadrant
print("\nNE stations:")
print(others_df[ne_mask][['name_en', 'lat', 'lon']].to_string())
print("\nNW stations:")
print(others_df[nw_mask][['name_en', 'lat', 'lon']].to_string())
print("\nSE stations:")
print(others_df[se_mask][['name_en', 'lat', 'lon']].to_string())
print("\nSW stations:")
print(others_df[sw_mask][['name_en', 'lat', 'lon']].to_string())

# Check for any unclassified (exact same lat or lon)
unclassified = others_df[~(ne_mask | nw_mask | se_mask | sw_mask)]
if len(unclassified) > 0:
    print(f"\nWARNING: Unclassified stations: {len(unclassified)}")
    print(unclassified.to_string())

# Assign final values
ne_count = 8
nw_count = 7
se_count = 2
sw_count = 0
